fullContentHtml:
UPSC NDA/ NA-II Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the answer Key for the post of National Defence Academy NDA & Naval Academy NA -II 2026 on the official website of UPSC. This recruitment was released for 394 posts. The online application process for UPSC NDA/ NA-II Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 20 May 2026, to 11 June 2026. The examination was held on 13 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSC NDA/ NA-II Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • UPSC NDA/ NA-II Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification Post Name Eligibility National Defence Academy Candidates must have completed their Intermediate or Equivalent Level of Exam from any Recognized Board.   1. Visit the official website.

  4. Download the answer key PDF.
